newsitem.title: USA: Instron to buy GRC Intl unit.
newsitem.headline: Instron to buy GRC Intl unit.

text.p: Instron Corp, a leading producer of instruments and systems for advanced materials testing, said Friday it had acquired the Dynatup unit of GRC International Inc.
Dynatup's product line of impact-testing equipment for the plastics industry will expand Instron's product offerings, Instron said.
Instron expects these products to complement its electro-mechanical testing machines, hardness testers and impact testers, and add more than $3.5 million in annual revenues.

"Dynatup is the market leader for impact testers in the plastics industry and has an excellent range of products which provides Instron the opportunity to leverage its manufacturing, distribution and service network to expand Dynatup's markets," said Instron Chief Executive James McConnell.
